title: Modern Annotation Syntax
summary: Annotations are evaluated objects that nothing enforces. Write them the modern way (builtin generics, X | None, collections.abc.Callable, Self) and prove it with typing.get_type_hints, keeping None in the type of a None default and annotating one element of a variadic parameter.

resources.label: PEP 585: Type Hinting Generics In Standard Collections
PEP 604: Allow writing union types as X | Y
